mintAuthority.summary: OUSD user minting requires USDC deposits, but the 48-hour Origin governance timelock can approve and mint-whitelist an arbitrary strategy whose mintForStrategy calls need no collateral transfer or durable supply ceiling. Economic mint power is unbounded despite continuous on-chain reconciliation; the separately authored 2-of-8 Strategist Safe and its partially reviewed modules prevent a complete governor-only execution certificate.

mintIncidents.summary: Origin Dollar's VaultCore mint logic was exploited through missing validation and reentrancy checks, inflating OUSD supply and draining about $7.7M from the vault.

controls.label: OUSD Vault (user mint/redeem)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095831, the OUSD token vaultAddress() names 0xe75d77b1865ae93c7eaa3040b038d7aa7bc02f70. Vault governor() and admin() both name 0x35918cde7233f2dd33fa41ae3cb6ae0e42e0e69f; implementation() remains 0x82948060c4b72684bededec342350ab344975145. User minting and redemption semantics are documented by Origin.

controls.label: OUSD Timelock (48h) + Origin Governance (AMO/strategy admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26113561 (hash 0xf8669491a2d5c3e0dfe4c4233ed6861dcbe45f046fac9804a60c40ae5ee6846e), Vault governor() returned this Timelock and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay through this block and confirming hasRole calls resolve PROPOSER_ROLE and EXECUTOR_ROLE solely to Origin DeFi Governance 0x1d3fbd4d129ddd2372ea85c5fa00b2682081c9ec, not a Safe. CANCELLER_ROLE belongs to that governor and 0xbe2ab3d3d8f6a32b96414ebbd865dbd276d3d899; TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE belongs only to the Timelock. Verified VaultAdmin permits the governor to approveStrategy and addStrategyToMintWhitelist, and VaultCore.mintForStrategy then mints arbitrary amounts to the whitelisted strategy without collateral transfer.

controls.label: OUSD Strategist Safe (strategy allocation)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26101011 (2026-10-02), Vault strategistAddr() remains this Safe, with eight owners, threshold 2, five enabled modules and zero guard. All five module runtimes exactly match their Blockscout verified deployed bytecode. AutoWithdrawalModule 0x90d588fc0ec3db9c4b417db4537fe08e063d2ae5 has immutable OUSD Vault/USDC/Safe targets and an external EOA operator 0x739212d5bafe6aac8be49a60b7d003bd41dbf38b. The operator can bypass the Safe's two-signature transaction flow for withdrawFromStrategy(address,address[],uint256[]) (0xae69f3cb), moving supported-strategy USDC back into the Vault to fund its withdrawal queue, bounded dynamically by min(queue shortfall, strategy balance). A pinned one-USDC eth_call as the Safe succeeds. This is verified reserve-transfer reach, not noninterference; it does not itself expose OUSD mint or upgrade selectors, arbitrary recipients, or delegatecall. Other modules automate mutable bribe targets, strategy rewards and OETH bridging; their complete transitive OUSD reach is not certified. No module-presence waiver, unbounded-loss claim or backing-horizon change is authored.

review.evidence: Historical review at Ethereum block 25530882 resolved token/Vault admin and governor to Timelock 0x35918cde7233f2dd33fa41ae3cb6ae0e42e0e69f and getMinDelay() to 172800; the token implementation was 0xa7b7c59a1705e4a624ea8a4ad8a06f9de22dcc33 and Vault implementation 0x82948060c4b72684bededec342350ab344975145. The 2026-08-15 reconciliation review established continuous on-chain reserve visibility and no supervisor/independent attestor. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 at Ethereum block 26113561 (hash 0xf8669491a2d5c3e0dfe4c4233ed6861dcbe45f046fac9804a60c40ae5ee6846e): verified VaultAdmin.approveStrategy and addStrategyToMintWhitelist admit arbitrary strategies, and VaultCore.mintForStrategy mints to an admitted strategy without checking a collateral transfer or durable supply bound. A one-OUSD eth_call from current whitelisted strategy 0x26a02ec47acc2a3442b757f45e0a82b8e993ce11 succeeded; no transaction was submitted. The earlier inference that a timelock makes economic cap semantics raiseable is superseded: D14 is unbounded, not an upgrade-only trigger. Full timelock role-event replay and confirming reads show Origin DeFi Governance 0x1d3fbd4d129ddd2372ea85c5fa00b2682081c9ec as sole proposer and executor; verified GovernorVotes uses getPastVotes. Vault strategistAddr() remains Safe 0x4ff1b9d9ba8558f5eafcec096318ea0d8b541971, with threshold 2 and eight owners. D29 is not certified: the separately authored Safe can-authorize root is not token governance, and its existing partial executionScope leaves mutable module targets, delegate/fallback, permissions, upgrades, bypasses and liability inventory open. No complete scope exists for every authored control. Continuous reconciliation therefore yields unbounded-reconciled, not unbounded-governed.
